caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass pitcher placed against a plain, light background. The pitcher has a broad, rounded body that narrows towards the top before flaring out again at the rim, which features three prominent horizontal ridges. The handle is attached to the upper rear of the vessel, sweeping in an arched shape from the shoulder of the pitcher to just below the rim, and includes a defined grip area at its bottom attachment. The lower portion of the pitcher is adorned with a repeated semi-circular arch motif encircling the base. The rendering is in black and white, utilizing shading and highlights to give the appearance of transparent glass and to depict the pitcher’s three-dimensional form. The background is left plain and unadorned, emphasizing the central object in the composition.
title: Pitcher
